features.name: Patient Registration
features.description: Patients can create and manage their accounts with personal and medical information.
user_stories: As a patient, I can register an account so that I can book appointments with doctors.
As a patient, I can update my profile information so that my records are current.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new patient, When they complete the registration form, Then an account is created and confirmation email is sent.
Given a registered patient, When they update their profile, Then the changes are saved and reflected immediately.

features.name: Appointment Scheduling
features.description: Patients can view available time slots and book appointments with doctors.
user_stories: As a patient, I can view available doctor schedules so that I can choose a convenient time.
As a patient, I can book an appointment so that I can visit the doctor at my selected time.
acceptance_criteria: Given available doctors, When a patient searches by specialty or date, Then matching available slots are displayed.
Given an available time slot, When a patient confirms booking, Then the appointment is reserved and confirmation is sent.

features.name: Appointment Management
features.description: Patients and doctors can view, reschedule, or cancel existing appointments.
user_stories: As a patient, I can cancel my appointment so that the slot becomes available for others.
As a doctor, I can view my appointment schedule so that I know my daily patient list.
acceptance_criteria: Given a booked appointment, When a patient cancels it, Then the slot is freed and notification is sent to the doctor.
Given a doctor login, When they access their dashboard, Then all scheduled appointments are displayed chronologically.

features.name: Doctor Profile Management
features.description: Doctors can manage their profiles, specialties, and availability schedules.
user_stories: As a doctor, I can set my available hours so that patients can only book during those times.
As a doctor, I can update my specialty information so that patients find me for relevant conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a doctor account, When they set availability hours, Then only those slots appear for patient booking.
Given a doctor profile, When specialty is updated, Then the changes are visible in search results immediately.

features.name: Notifications and Reminders
features.description: System sends automated reminders and notifications for appointments and updates.
user_stories: As a patient, I can receive appointment reminders so that I don't miss my scheduled visit.
As a doctor, I can receive notifications of new bookings so that I stay informed of my schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Given an upcoming appointment, When it is 24 hours away, Then a reminder email and SMS are sent to the patient.
Given a new appointment booking, When it is confirmed, Then the doctor receives an instant notification.
